propositions: Lean discovery row retains four DSSE signature fields (authorship_ledger, attestations, signature, keyring) that account for 88% of payload bytes despite include_body=False dropping bodies
Two read backends (list_states and TicketView.list_by_query) spell the lean projection separately, allowing them to drift
Three discovery surfaces (CLI rebar list, MCP list_tickets, MCP ready_tickets) must share a single canonical lean_projection that drops both bodies and all four signature fields consistently
ready_tickets currently returns full shape with no opt-out; narrowing to lean by default with full=True opt-out is a deliberate pre-1.0 breaking change
Backend parity must be tested via parent-bounded TicketQuery against both backends to confirm identical key sets and that include_body=True still carries bodies
